newsitem.title: FRANCE: Alcatel has no comment on Thomson.
newsitem.headline: Alcatel has no comment on Thomson.

text.p: Alcatel Alsthom said it had no comment on renewed newspaper speculation that it could team up with Aerospatiale and Dassault Aviation to bid for the state's 60 percent stake in Thomson-CSF.

These rumours first surfaced in December when Defence Ministry officials were quoted in newspapers as saying Aerospatiale/Dassault -- set for a merger themselves this year -- were weighing a bid for Thomson-CSF.
Aerospatiale said at the time that it needed government permission for such a bid and added such a link-up had industrial logic.

"Our position is unchanged. We are waiting for the new terms of the Thomson privatisation to be set before we give a reaction," an Alcatel spokesman said on Wednesday while confirming the company's continued interest in Thomson.
Alcatel had originally made an offer for Thomson SA, which includes both consumer electronics group Thomson Multimedia and the 60 percent stake in defence electronics group Thomson-CSF.
But the government opted for a rival offer by Lagardere Groupe and Daewoo Electronics.
It had to reverse this decision when the independent Privatisation Commission balked against terms of part of the deal.
